avis.titre: Brightening Results in Weeks: A Glow-Boosting Reti
avis.texte: I've been using the Multi-Action Super-C Retinol Serum consistently for almost three weeks now, applying it every night as part of my skincare routine. The packaging comes with a dropper, which I really appreciate—it makes application clean and mess-free. The serum itself is a vibrant orange color, and a little goes a long way. After just a few weeks of use, I've noticed visible improvements in my skin. My complexion looks noticeably brighter and more even-toned, and my face feels less oily overall. I have acne-prone skin, and I'm happy to report that this product hasn't caused any irritation or breakouts so far. In fact, it's helped reduce some of the dullness I used to struggle with—my skin has a healthy, natural glow now. The combination of Niacinamide and Retinol is powerful. It works well to smooth out uneven texture and lighten dark spots, but it can be a bit drying, which is expected with retinol-based products. I definitely recommend following it up with a good moisturizer to keep your skin balanced and hydrated. One thing I'm not a fan of is the fragrance. It's a bit strong for my preference, and I usually lean toward fragrance-free products, especially because I avoid anything with essential oils due to potential sensitivity. That said, the serum absolutely delivers on its promises. If you're looking for a product that can help brighten, correct skin tone, and add a subtle glow—especially in a short period—this is definitely worth trying. Just be sure to moisturize

avis.titre: One of my favorite serums of all time!
